Act.description: The legislative act element (akn:act). Main content container of an AkomaNtoso document. The @name attribute specifies the type of act (e.g. 'publicLaw').

act_name.description: Type of act (@name attribute of akn:act), e.g. 'publicLaw'.

components_ref.description: The documents embedded in this act (akn:components).

Act.title: Act

ActBody.description: The main body of the act (akn:body), containing the legislative hierarchy. Allowed direct children are restricted to: book, title, part, chapter, subchapter, section, subsection, level, article, transitional, proviso. No other elements are permitted (FLX-BD-001).
ActBody.title: ActBody

ActMeta.description: Metadata section of the act (akn:meta). Contains FRBR identification (Work, Expression, Manifestation levels) and named reference definitions.
ActMeta.title: ActMeta

ActTypeEnum.description: Type of legislative act expressed in the akn:act/@name attribute.
ActTypeEnum.title: ActTypeEnum

Article.description: An article, the primary legislative unit (akn:article). Constraints (FLX-ART-*): - akn:num is mandatory (FLX-ART-001) - only heading elements (num, heading, subheading) plus akn:paragraph and akn:subdivision are allowed as children (FLX-ART-002) - requires unique @eId (FLX-ART-003)

eId.description: Unique element identifier within the document (@eId). Required by Fedlex Schematron on all hierarchical structure elements, articles, subdivisions, and paragraphs. Follows the AKN eId naming convention (hierarchical path notation), e.g. 'ti_1', 'ch_1', 'art_1', 'art_1-para_1'.

heading.description: Heading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:heading). May contain inline markup including akn:br (FLX-TXT-001: br permitted in heading context). Must precede subheading (FLX-HD-004, FLX-HD-005).

num.description: The article number (e.g. 'Art. 1'). Mandatory in every article (FLX-ART-001).

paragraphs.description: Paragraph child elements (akn:paragraph) within an article or subdivision.

subdivisions.description: Subdivision child elements (akn:subdivision) within an article.

subheading.description: Subheading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:subheading). The fedlex:role='reference' attribute marks it as a reference heading (FLX-XF-005). Max one subheading per element (FLX-HD-006).

Article.title: Article

AuthorialNote.description: An authorial footnote (akn:authorialNote). Recurses into block content: it contains one or more akn:p paragraphs, which themselves carry inline content.

content_blocks.description: Block-level content in reading order: paragraphs, lists and tables as they follow one another in the document.

element_type.description: Type designator discriminating the concrete subclass of an abstract base: InlineElement (TextRun, Ref, B, I, Sup, Span, Br, Inline, Placeholder, AuthorialNote) or BlockElement (BlockParagraph, BlockList, Table).

AuthorialNote.title: AuthorialNote

element_type.description: Type designator discriminating the concrete subclass of an abstract base: InlineElement (TextRun, Ref, B, I, Sup, Span, Br, Inline, Placeholder, AuthorialNote) or BlockElement (BlockParagraph, BlockList, Table).

inline_content.description: Ordered mixed content: a sequence of text runs and inline-markup elements (InlineElement subclasses). Document order is preserved by list order. Allowed inline elements: akn:ref, akn:b, akn:i, akn:sup, akn:span, akn:authorialNote, akn:inline, akn:placeholder, akn:br.

Block.description: A generic block (akn:block) whose @name states its purpose; carries mixed content.

inline_content.description: Ordered mixed content: a sequence of text runs and inline-markup elements (InlineElement subclasses). Document order is preserved by list order. Allowed inline elements: akn:ref, akn:b, akn:i, akn:sup, akn:span, akn:authorialNote, akn:inline, akn:placeholder, akn:br.

Block.title: Block

BlockElement.description: Abstract base for a block-level element inside content, a list item or a table cell (akn:p, akn:blockList, akn:table).

element_type.description: Type designator discriminating the concrete subclass of an abstract base: InlineElement (TextRun, Ref, B, I, Sup, Span, Br, Inline, Placeholder, AuthorialNote) or BlockElement (BlockParagraph, BlockList, Table).

BlockElement.title: BlockElement

BlockList.description: A block list of enumerated or lettered items (akn:blockList), optionally introduced by an akn:listIntroduction element.

eId.description: Unique element identifier within the document (@eId). Required by Fedlex Schematron on all hierarchical structure elements, articles, subdivisions, and paragraphs. Follows the AKN eId naming convention (hierarchical path notation), e.g. 'ti_1', 'ch_1', 'art_1', 'art_1-para_1'.

element_type.description: Type designator discriminating the concrete subclass of an abstract base: InlineElement (TextRun, Ref, B, I, Sup, Span, Br, Inline, Placeholder, AuthorialNote) or BlockElement (BlockParagraph, BlockList, Table).

list_introduction.description: Optional introduction text before a block list (akn:listIntroduction).

BlockList.title: BlockList

BlockListItem.description: A single item in a block list (akn:item). Carries a num label and block content directly: prose paragraphs (akn:p) and optionally nested block lists.

content_blocks.description: Block-level content in reading order: paragraphs, lists and tables as they follow one another in the document.

eId.description: Unique element identifier within the document (@eId). Required by Fedlex Schematron on all hierarchical structure elements, articles, subdivisions, and paragraphs. Follows the AKN eId naming convention (hierarchical path notation), e.g. 'ti_1', 'ch_1', 'art_1', 'art_1-para_1'.

num.description: Number element for a hierarchical structure or article (akn:num). In articles, num is mandatory (FLX-ART-001). The num element must precede heading and subheading (FLX-HD-001, FLX-HD-002, FLX-HD-003).

BlockListItem.title: BlockListItem

BlockNameEnum.description: Block purposes Fedlex uses in akn:block/@name.
BlockNameEnum.title: BlockNameEnum

BlockParagraph.description: A prose paragraph within content (akn:p). May contain mixed content with inline markup (XmlContent type). Note: akn:br is not allowed here, only in heading elements (FLX-TXT-001).

element_type.description: Type designator discriminating the concrete subclass of an abstract base: InlineElement (TextRun, Ref, B, I, Sup, Span, Br, Inline, Placeholder, AuthorialNote) or BlockElement (BlockParagraph, BlockList, Table).

fedlex_role.description: Fedlex extension attribute fedlex:role. FLX-XF-003 permits 'marginal' (only on akn:level, FLX-XF-004) and 'reference' (only on akn:subheading, FLX-XF-005); the published Federal Constitution additionally carries 'heading' on a preamble paragraph.

inline_content.description: Ordered mixed content: a sequence of text runs and inline-markup elements (InlineElement subclasses). Document order is preserved by list order. Allowed inline elements: akn:ref, akn:b, akn:i, akn:sup, akn:span, akn:authorialNote, akn:inline, akn:placeholder, akn:br.

BlockParagraph.title: BlockParagraph

Book.description: Book-level division of an act (akn:book). Allowed children: title, part, chapter, subchapter, section, subsection, level (FLX-HR-001-bk). Requires unique @eId (FLX-HR-002-bk).

eId.description: Unique element identifier within the document (@eId). Required by Fedlex Schematron on all hierarchical structure elements, articles, subdivisions, and paragraphs. Follows the AKN eId naming convention (hierarchical path notation), e.g. 'ti_1', 'ch_1', 'art_1', 'art_1-para_1'.

heading.description: Heading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:heading). May contain inline markup including akn:br (FLX-TXT-001: br permitted in heading context). Must precede subheading (FLX-HD-004, FLX-HD-005).

num.description: Number element for a hierarchical structure or article (akn:num). In articles, num is mandatory (FLX-ART-001). The num element must precede heading and subheading (FLX-HD-001, FLX-HD-002, FLX-HD-003).

subheading.description: Subheading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:subheading). The fedlex:role='reference' attribute marks it as a reference heading (FLX-XF-005). Max one subheading per element (FLX-HD-006).

Book.title: Book

Br.description: A line break (akn:br). In the (currently disabled) FLX-TXT-001 rule, br is restricted to heading-type elements.

element_type.description: Type designator discriminating the concrete subclass of an abstract base: InlineElement (TextRun, Ref, B, I, Sup, Span, Br, Inline, Placeholder, AuthorialNote) or BlockElement (BlockParagraph, BlockList, Table).

Br.title: Br

Chapter.description: Chapter-level division of an act (akn:chapter). Allowed children: subchapter, section, subsection, level, and directly article (FLX-HR-001-ch). Requires unique @eId (FLX-HR-002-ch).

eId.description: Unique element identifier within the document (@eId). Required by Fedlex Schematron on all hierarchical structure elements, articles, subdivisions, and paragraphs. Follows the AKN eId naming convention (hierarchical path notation), e.g. 'ti_1', 'ch_1', 'art_1', 'art_1-para_1'.

heading.description: Heading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:heading). May contain inline markup including akn:br (FLX-TXT-001: br permitted in heading context). Must precede subheading (FLX-HD-004, FLX-HD-005).

num.description: Number element for a hierarchical structure or article (akn:num). In articles, num is mandatory (FLX-ART-001). The num element must precede heading and subheading (FLX-HD-001, FLX-HD-002, FLX-HD-003).

subheading.description: Subheading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:subheading). The fedlex:role='reference' attribute marks it as a reference heading (FLX-XF-005). Max one subheading per element (FLX-HD-006).

Chapter.title: Chapter

Components.description: Container for the documents embedded in an act (akn:components), such as its annex.
Components.title: Components

Container.description: A generic container (akn:container) whose @name states its purpose.
Container.title: Container

ContainerNameEnum.description: Container purposes Fedlex uses in akn:container/@name.
ContainerNameEnum.title: ContainerNameEnum

Content.description: The content of a paragraph (akn:content). Contains block-level elements: akn:p (prose), akn:blockList (numbered/lettered lists), akn:table. When used inside a akn:level, must contain an akn:mod element (FLX-HR-003).

content_blocks.description: Block-level content in reading order: paragraphs, lists and tables as they follow one another in the document.

Content.title: Content

Doc.description: An embedded document (akn:doc). Its @name states the kind; Fedlex uses 'annex'. It carries its own identification, which in the Fedlex files repeats the URIs of the act it belongs to.
Doc.title: Doc

DocNameEnum.description: Kinds of embedded document Fedlex uses in akn:doc/@name.
DocNameEnum.title: DocNameEnum

DocumentLanguageEnum.description: Language codes used for Swiss federal documents.
DocumentLanguageEnum.title: DocumentLanguageEnum

FRBRAuthor.description: An author or rights-holder entry for an FRBR entity (akn:FRBRauthor). @href references the organization; @as references the role (both as intra-document anchors).

as_role.description: Role the author plays (akn:FRBRauthor/@as), as an anchor reference, e.g. '#publisher', '#rightsHolder'.

href.description: URI reference (@href), used for links to organizations, roles, or external URIs.

FRBRAuthor.title: FRBRAuthor

FRBRDate.description: A date entry for an FRBR entity (akn:FRBRdate). The @name attribute uses Fedlex/JoLux vocabulary: jolux:dateEntryInForce, jolux:dateDocument, jolux:dateApplicability.

frbr_date_name.description: Type of this date (akn:FRBRdate/@name). Fedlex uses the JoLux vocabulary; the permissible values of FrbrDateNameEnum carry the corresponding ELI property. Cantonal publishers use their own designations, which is why a free string remains admissible.

FRBRDate.title: FRBRDate

FRBRExpression.description: FRBR Expression level (akn:FRBRExpression): a specific language version of the legislative text. Identified by an ELI URI that includes the language code.

frbr_authors.description: Author/rights-holder entries for this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRauthor).

frbr_dates.description: Date entries for this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRdate). Multiple entries for different event types (dateEntryInForce, dateDocument, dateApplicability).

frbr_this.description: Canonical ELI URI of this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRthis/@value).

frbr_uri.description: Base ELI URI of this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRuri/@value).

FRBRExpression.title: FRBRExpression

FRBRManifestation.description: FRBR Manifestation level (akn:FRBRManifestation): a specific file format of the expression. For Fedlex XML files the format value is 'xml'. The optional fedlex:generator attribute is only permitted here (FLX-XF-002).

frbr_authors.description: Author/rights-holder entries for this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRauthor).

frbr_dates.description: Date entries for this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRdate). Multiple entries for different event types (dateEntryInForce, dateDocument, dateApplicability).

frbr_format.description: File format of this manifestation (akn:FRBRformat/@value), typically 'xml'.

frbr_this.description: Canonical ELI URI of this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRthis/@value).

frbr_uri.description: Base ELI URI of this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRuri/@value).

FRBRManifestation.title: FRBRManifestation

FRBRName.description: A multilingual name entry for the FRBR Work (akn:FRBRname). Carries the full official name and an optional abbreviation. One entry per language.

short_form.description: Short form abbreviation of the legislative name (@shortForm), e.g. 'BV' (German), 'Cst.' (French).

value.description: Generic value attribute (@value) used across multiple AkomaNtoso elements.

FRBRName.title: FRBRName

FRBRWork.description: FRBR Work level (akn:FRBRWork): the abstract legislative text independent of language or version. Contains ELI URIs, Fedlex/JoLux dates, authors, country code (CH), SR number, and multilingual names with short forms.

frbr_authoritative.description: Whether this is the authoritative version (akn:FRBRauthoritative/@value).

frbr_authors.description: Author/rights-holder entries for this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRauthor).

frbr_country.description: Country code for this legislative text (akn:FRBRcountry/@value), e.g. 'CH'.

frbr_dates.description: Date entries for this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRdate). Multiple entries for different event types (dateEntryInForce, dateDocument, dateApplicability).

frbr_names.description: Multilingual name entries for the FRBR Work (akn:FRBRname). One entry per language.

frbr_this.description: Canonical ELI URI of this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRthis/@value).

frbr_uri.description: Base ELI URI of this FRBR entity (akn:FRBRuri/@value).

FRBRWork.title: FRBRWork

FedlexDocument.description: Root element of a Fedlex AkomaNtoso document (akn:akomaNtoso). Must contain exactly one akn:act element and no other children (FLX-RT-001). Carries the AkomaNtoso namespace declaration and the Fedlex extension namespace.

act_ref.description: The legislative act (akn:act). Must be the only child of akn:akomaNtoso (FLX-RT-001).

FedlexDocument.title: FedlexDocument

FedlexRoleEnum.description: Allowed values for the fedlex:role extension attribute (FLX-XF-003). 'marginal' is only permitted on akn:level elements (FLX-XF-004). 'reference' is only permitted on akn:subheading elements (FLX-XF-005).
FedlexRoleEnum.title: FedlexRoleEnum

FormatType.description: A holder for akn:FRBRformat: a @value (typically 'xml') plus the optional fedlex:generator extension attribute (FLX-XF-002).

fedlex_generator.description: Fedlex extension attribute fedlex:generator on akn:FRBRformat[@value='xml']. Identifies the tool that generated the XML file. Only allowed on FRBRformat (FLX-XF-002).

value.description: Generic value attribute (@value) used across multiple AkomaNtoso elements.

FormatType.title: FormatType

FrbrDateNameEnum.description: Date types Fedlex uses in akn:FRBRdate/@name, taken from the JoLux vocabulary. Cantonal publishers use their own designations; the slot therefore also admits a free string.
FrbrDateNameEnum.title: FrbrDateNameEnum

element_type.description: Type designator discriminating the concrete subclass of an abstract base: InlineElement (TextRun, Ref, B, I, Sup, Span, Br, Inline, Placeholder, AuthorialNote) or BlockElement (BlockParagraph, BlockList, Table).

inline_content.description: Ordered mixed content: a sequence of text runs and inline-markup elements (InlineElement subclasses). Document order is preserved by list order. Allowed inline elements: akn:ref, akn:b, akn:i, akn:sup, akn:span, akn:authorialNote, akn:inline, akn:placeholder, akn:br.

Identification.description: FRBR identification block (akn:identification) grouping Work, Expression, and Manifestation descriptions. The @source attribute references the responsible organization as an intra-document anchor (e.g. '#ch.bk').

source.description: Anchor reference to the responsible organization (@source), e.g. '#ch.bk'.

Identification.title: Identification

Inline.description: A named presentational inline (akn:inline), e.g. name='man-font-style-normal'.

element_type.description: Type designator discriminating the concrete subclass of an abstract base: InlineElement (TextRun, Ref, B, I, Sup, Span, Br, Inline, Placeholder, AuthorialNote) or BlockElement (BlockParagraph, BlockList, Table).

inline_content.description: Ordered mixed content: a sequence of text runs and inline-markup elements (InlineElement subclasses). Document order is preserved by list order. Allowed inline elements: akn:ref, akn:b, akn:i, akn:sup, akn:span, akn:authorialNote, akn:inline, akn:placeholder, akn:br.

Inline.title: Inline

InlineElement.description: Abstract base for a modeled inline-markup element inside mixed content.

element_type.description: Type designator discriminating the concrete subclass of an abstract base: InlineElement (TextRun, Ref, B, I, Sup, Span, Br, Inline, Placeholder, AuthorialNote) or BlockElement (BlockParagraph, BlockList, Table).

InlineElement.title: InlineElement

LanguageType.description: A holder carrying a single @language attribute (akn:FRBRlanguage).
LanguageType.title: LanguageType

Level.description: Transparent structural division (akn:level). A level is 'transparent': its allowed children are the same as those of its nearest non-level ancestor (FLX-HR-001-lv). A level containing akn:content is only permitted when the content includes a modification element (akn:mod) — used for amending acts (FLX-HR-003). The fedlex:role='marginal' attribute marks it as a marginal note (FLX-XF-004). Requires unique @eId (FLX-HR-002-lv, FLX-HR-004).

eId.description: Unique element identifier within the document (@eId). Required by Fedlex Schematron on all hierarchical structure elements, articles, subdivisions, and paragraphs. Follows the AKN eId naming convention (hierarchical path notation), e.g. 'ti_1', 'ch_1', 'art_1', 'art_1-para_1'.

fedlex_role.description: When set, must be 'marginal' (FLX-XF-004). The value 'reference' is not allowed on level; it is reserved for subheading (FLX-XF-005).

heading.description: Heading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:heading). May contain inline markup including akn:br (FLX-TXT-001: br permitted in heading context). Must precede subheading (FLX-HD-004, FLX-HD-005).

num.description: Number element for a hierarchical structure or article (akn:num). In articles, num is mandatory (FLX-ART-001). The num element must precede heading and subheading (FLX-HD-001, FLX-HD-002, FLX-HD-003).

subheading.description: Subheading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:subheading). The fedlex:role='reference' attribute marks it as a reference heading (FLX-XF-005). Max one subheading per element (FLX-HD-006).

Level.title: Level

MainBody.description: Body of an embedded document (akn:mainBody). Unlike the act body it holds paragraphs and levels directly, without the legislative hierarchy.

content_blocks.description: Block-level content in reading order: paragraphs, lists and tables as they follow one another in the document.

MainBody.title: MainBody

MixedText.description: Reusable mixed-content holder: an ordered run of text and inline markup. Used as the range for num, heading, subheading, listIntroduction, docTitle, so the wrapping element name comes from the referring slot's xml_element.

eId.description: Unique element identifier within the document (@eId). Required by Fedlex Schematron on all hierarchical structure elements, articles, subdivisions, and paragraphs. Follows the AKN eId naming convention (hierarchical path notation), e.g. 'ti_1', 'ch_1', 'art_1', 'art_1-para_1'.

inline_content.description: Ordered mixed content: a sequence of text runs and inline-markup elements (InlineElement subclasses). Document order is preserved by list order. Allowed inline elements: akn:ref, akn:b, akn:i, akn:sup, akn:span, akn:authorialNote, akn:inline, akn:placeholder, akn:br.

MixedText.title: MixedText

Paragraph.description: A paragraph within an article or subdivision (akn:paragraph). Constraints (FLX-PR-*): - only heading elements and akn:content are allowed as children (FLX-PR-001) - only permitted as a direct child of akn:article or akn:subdivision (FLX-PR-002) - requires unique @eId (FLX-PR-003)

eId.description: Unique element identifier within the document (@eId). Required by Fedlex Schematron on all hierarchical structure elements, articles, subdivisions, and paragraphs. Follows the AKN eId naming convention (hierarchical path notation), e.g. 'ti_1', 'ch_1', 'art_1', 'art_1-para_1'.

heading.description: Heading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:heading). May contain inline markup including akn:br (FLX-TXT-001: br permitted in heading context). Must precede subheading (FLX-HD-004, FLX-HD-005).

num.description: Number element for a hierarchical structure or article (akn:num). In articles, num is mandatory (FLX-ART-001). The num element must precede heading and subheading (FLX-HD-001, FLX-HD-002, FLX-HD-003).

Paragraph.title: Paragraph

Part.description: Part-level division of an act (akn:part). Allowed children: chapter, subchapter, section, subsection, level (FLX-HR-001-pt). Requires unique @eId (FLX-HR-002-pt).

eId.description: Unique element identifier within the document (@eId). Required by Fedlex Schematron on all hierarchical structure elements, articles, subdivisions, and paragraphs. Follows the AKN eId naming convention (hierarchical path notation), e.g. 'ti_1', 'ch_1', 'art_1', 'art_1-para_1'.

heading.description: Heading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:heading). May contain inline markup including akn:br (FLX-TXT-001: br permitted in heading context). Must precede subheading (FLX-HD-004, FLX-HD-005).

num.description: Number element for a hierarchical structure or article (akn:num). In articles, num is mandatory (FLX-ART-001). The num element must precede heading and subheading (FLX-HD-001, FLX-HD-002, FLX-HD-003).

subheading.description: Subheading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:subheading). The fedlex:role='reference' attribute marks it as a reference heading (FLX-XF-005). Max one subheading per element (FLX-HD-006).

Part.title: Part

Placeholder.description: A placeholder for stripped content (akn:placeholder), carrying the fedlex:message extension attribute (e.g. 'E40S10-TAB').

element_type.description: Type designator discriminating the concrete subclass of an abstract base: InlineElement (TextRun, Ref, B, I, Sup, Span, Br, Inline, Placeholder, AuthorialNote) or BlockElement (BlockParagraph, BlockList, Table).

fedlex_message.description: Fedlex extension attribute fedlex:message on akn:placeholder, marking stripped content (e.g. 'E40S10-TAB').

inline_content.description: Ordered mixed content: a sequence of text runs and inline-markup elements (InlineElement subclasses). Document order is preserved by list order. Allowed inline elements: akn:ref, akn:b, akn:i, akn:sup, akn:span, akn:authorialNote, akn:inline, akn:placeholder, akn:br.

Placeholder.title: Placeholder

Preamble.description: The preamble of the act (akn:preamble), containing introductory prose paragraphs preceding the operative body.

content_blocks.description: Block-level content in reading order: paragraphs, lists and tables as they follow one another in the document.

Preamble.title: Preamble

Preface.description: The preface of the act (akn:preface), containing the document number and title. Fedlex Schematron requires both akn:docNumber (FLX-PF-001) and akn:docTitle (FLX-PF-002) to be present inside a akn:p element.

preface_paragraphs.description: The akn:p paragraphs of the preface, wrapping docNumber/docTitle.

Preface.title: Preface

PrefaceP.description: A preface paragraph (akn:p) that wraps the document number and/or title. Fedlex requires akn:docNumber and akn:docTitle to sit inside a akn:p of the preface (FLX-PF-001/002).

doc_number.description: Document number in the preface (akn:docNumber). Required by FLX-PF-001. Typically the SR number, e.g. '101'.

doc_title.description: Document title in the preface (akn:docTitle). Required by FLX-PF-002. May contain inline markup and akn:br for line breaks.

inline_content.description: Ordered mixed content: a sequence of text runs and inline-markup elements (InlineElement subclasses). Document order is preserved by list order. Allowed inline elements: akn:ref, akn:b, akn:i, akn:sup, akn:span, akn:authorialNote, akn:inline, akn:placeholder, akn:br.

PrefaceP.title: PrefaceP

Proviso.description: A proviso in the body of an act (akn:proviso). Permitted as a top-level body element (FLX-BD-001). Typically appears after the main articles.

eId.description: Unique element identifier within the document (@eId). Required by Fedlex Schematron on all hierarchical structure elements, articles, subdivisions, and paragraphs. Follows the AKN eId naming convention (hierarchical path notation), e.g. 'ti_1', 'ch_1', 'art_1', 'art_1-para_1'.

heading.description: Heading element for a hierarchical structure (akn:heading). May contain inline markup including akn:br (FLX-TXT-001: br permitted in heading context). Must precede subheading (FLX-HD-004, FLX-HD-005).

num.description: Number element for a hierarchical structure or article (akn:num). In articles, num is mandatory (FLX-ART-001). The num element must precede heading and subheading (FLX-HD-001, FLX-HD-002, FLX-HD-003).

paragraphs.description: Paragraph child elements (akn:paragraph) within an article or subdivision.

Proviso.title: Proviso

Ref.description: An inline reference (akn:ref). Carries @href, and for internal SR cross-references the Fedlex extension attributes fedlex:rs and fedlex:rs-uri.

element_type.description: Type designator discriminating the concrete subclass of an abstract base: InlineElement (TextRun, Ref, B, I, Sup, Span, Br, Inline, Placeholder, AuthorialNote) or BlockElement (BlockParagraph, BlockList, Table).

fedlex_rs.description: Fedlex extension attribute fedlex:rs on akn:ref: the SR number of the referenced law (e.g. '641.20').

fedlex_rs_uri.description: Fedlex extension attribute fedlex:rs-uri on akn:ref: the ELI URI of the referenced law's systematic-collection entry.

href.description: URI reference (@href), used for links to organizations, roles, or external URIs.

inline_content.description: Ordered mixed content: a sequence of text runs and inline-markup elements (InlineElement subclasses). Document order is preserved by list order. Allowed inline elements: akn:ref, akn:b, akn:i, akn:sup, akn:span, akn:authorialNote, akn:inline, akn:placeholder, akn:br.

Ref.title: Ref

References.description: Named reference definitions used across the document (akn:references). Defines organizations, roles, and other entities that are referenced by anchor (@href='#eId') elsewhere in the document.

source.description: Anchor reference to the responsible organization (@source), e.g. '#ch.bk'.

tlc_organizations.description: Named organization references in the document (akn:TLCOrganization).

tlc_references.description: Generic named references in the document (akn:TLCReference).

tlc_roles.description: Named role references in the document (akn:TLCRole).

References.title: References
